timeline.privateThought: Rajeev's previously established one-sided attraction mixes with suspicion; he does not know the joint purchase explanation.
hooks: The parcel is with Rajeev; no clothing sets remain. Marriage speculation becomes a future family conflict.

prose.text: 12:03. Mahendra ne Rajeev ko phone kiya. Damaged parcel ab kai baar desks badal chuka tha; bahar Ankita ka naam ab bhi clearly tha.

prose.speaker: Mahendra
prose.text: Rajeev ji, aapki bahu ka personal courier yahan custody mein hai. Seal damage ho gaya tha. Aap le jaayein?

prose.speaker: Rajeev
prose.text: Maine toh suna tha gate par hi rakhna tha. Committee office mein kaise pahuncha?

prose.speaker: Mahendra
prose.text: Address verification ka issue ho gaya. Main box aapko de raha hoon.

Rajeev ne carton khola nahi, lekin loose edge se sealed personal item aur leaflet ke corners dikh gaye. Original total count aur chhe missing sets ke baare mein use kuch pata nahi tha; ek set box mein abhi tha. Usne box apne bag mein carefully rakh liya.
Rajeev ko breakfast ki Ankita ki assured smile yaad aayi. Uski pehle se dabayi ek-tarfa ruchi ab is private parcel ko dekhkar aur uljhan mein badal gayi.
Ek pal ko usne socha ki shayad woh Ankita ke private life ko samajhta hai. Phir bhi uske paas us marriage ke baare mein koi haqeeqat ya explanation nahi thi.

prose.speaker: Rajeev
prose.text: Theek hai. Main Ankita ko de dunga. Seal kiske paas se damaged mila tha, register mein note karwa dijiye.

prose.speaker: Mahendra
prose.text: Haan, dekh lenge.
12:26. Rajeev box lekar ghar ki taraf gaya. Uske paas damaged outer parcel ke andar ek bacha hua clothing set, personal item aur papers the. Usne khud koi set nahi nikala.

timeline.title: Six Men, Six Different Secrets
timeline.action: In a committee gathering the five fathers-in-law and chairman discuss an improper rumour about Kabir and Ankita's marriage. The four visiting elders have each kept a separate set and hide that fact from everyone else. Rajeev hears suggestive questions without learning the theft chain. Mahendra avoids acknowledging his own removal.
dialogue: Rajeev ji, Kabir aur Ankita sab theek hain na?
Haan, bilkul. Aap aisa kyun pooch rahe hain?
Nahi nahi, bas aise hi. Community mein sab ek doosre ka khayal rakhte hain.
Personal baaton ko personal rehne dijiye.
timeline.herReaction: Ankita absent and unaware of gossip.
timeline.privateThought: Each man now has a different self-serving interpretation of private information; none has evidence of an unhappy marriage.
hooks: They are all aware something private was exposed, but unaware of each other's secret removals. Rajeev begins suspecting impropriety.

prose.text: 12:30. Committee-office veranda mein Mahendra, Om, Subhash, Mohan, Arvind aur Rajeev ek routine society discussion ke liye mile. Gopal gate duty par hi tha; woh iss meeting mein nahi aaya.

prose.speaker: Om
prose.text: Subah courier-log mein itna confusion kis baat ka tha?

prose.speaker: Mahendra
prose.text: Address problem tha. Rajeev ji ne parcel collect kar liya.

prose.speaker: Subhash
prose.text: Personal parcels ko committee table par rakhna hi nahi chahiye.

prose.speaker: Mohan
prose.text: Haan, warna log apne-apne matlab nikaalte hain.
Kisi ne doosre ke bag ki taraf nahi dekha. Har ek aadmi ke paas apna chhupaya hua reason tha ki conversation jaldi khatam ho.

prose.speaker: Arvind
prose.text: Naam aate hi log sawal poochne lagte hain. Kabir aur Ankita ke ghar ki baat bhi chhed denge.

prose.speaker: Rajeev
prose.text: Ghar ki koi problem mere saamne nahi hai. Bina jaane kuch assume mat kariye.

prose.speaker: Mahendra
prose.text: Bilkul. Lekin personal baatein personal hi rahni chahiye.

prose.speaker: Om
prose.text: Tab toh humein sabse pehle apne hi questions bandh karne chahiye.
Ek pal ke liye sab chup rahe. Subhash ne file band ki; Mohan ne cup seedha kiya. Mahendra ne register ki taraf dekhna shuru kar diya, jaise waqt se pehle discussion khatam karna chahta ho.

Mahendra ko apni private curiosity yaad thi; Om, Subhash, Mohan aur Arvind apne-apne secret ko normal chehron ke peeche chhupa rahe the. Rajeev ghar ki taraf se sach jaane bina sochta raha. Gopal door gate par akela apni hi kalpana mein tha.
Saat alag minds, saat ek-tarfa attractions—lekin Ankita ko inmein se kisi ki private soch, kisi removal, kisi gossip ka pata nahi tha.

12:50. Meeting toot gayi. Kisi ko nahi pata chala ki doosre ne bhi clothing set liya hai. Ankita Cyber City office mein thi, abhi bhi production-release work par focused; reader ke paas saat alag future hooks aur ek missing-parcel mystery reh gayi.
